content: {"like": ["The pilot was fine for the first 15 minutes and engaging", "Melissa Benoist manages her in‑costume scenes quite well", "The title character’s strong and confident portrayal as Supergirl"], "dislike": ["The pilot crashed early into the next segment and became hard to follow", "The second half was worse with over‑acting and a mockfest that made the show feel lame", "The show’s target demographic was unclear and the humor felt forced", "The production seemed to regress with excessive computer‑generated effects and poor design", "The show violated the Supergirl‑Jimmy Olsen franchise expectations", "The character was called Kara instead of her secret identity name of Linda", "The producers skipped the teenage supergirl angle and made the lines dumbed‑down to a grade‑school level", "The show was politically correct and extremely tame", "The Linda Lee Danvers scenes were weak compared to the in‑costume scenes", "The aging of actors like Chyler Leigh and Calista Flockhart was noticeable"]}
